_meta.rationale: About-team primary display element is .at__title (ABOUT_TEAM_BODY line 546); .at__avatar carries the radius slot. The :root override forces --ds-font-display to Plus Jakarta Sans. Phase 3.2 strips photo avatars so avatars must render as the surface-2 circle stub (no ). Negative trademark assertion mirrors slug=aeon strip targets.
gaps: No source-of-truth file pins per-brand --ds-radius-full or surface-2 hex; computed_css palette assertion deferred.
Avatar-strip assertion is bounded to absence of children inside .at__member; richer photo-strip checks live in the Phase 3.2 test (out of fidelity-gate scope).

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.at__title'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('plus jakarta sans'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['aeon.co/logo', 'aeon-logo', 'aeon-wordmark', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const members = document.querySelectorAll('.at__member'); if (members.length === 0) return false; for (const m of members) { if (m.querySelector('img')) return false; } return true; })()
